method: Manual review against official venue, operator, hotel or public-agency pages. A verified capacity is only applied when the public source identifies a named space and capacity. Other values remain clearly labelled as reference records requiring direct confirmation.

venues.auditSummary: The integrated resort combines large convention spaces, ballrooms, theatres, restaurants and hotel infrastructure in one Marina Bay complex.
planningConsiderations: Confirm which MICE space is being quoted rather than using a property-wide maximum.
Check loading routes, production access windows and stage footprint early.
Plan guest movement carefully when several spaces or hotel towers are involved.

venues.auditSummary: Gardens by the Bay offers recognisable Singapore landscapes ranging from large lawns to conservatory and waterfront-adjacent settings.
planningConsiderations: Build a wet-weather and heat-management plan for outdoor programmes.
Confirm ground protection, utilities, public access and permitted production zones.
Allow for long guest and supplier movement routes across the gardens.

venues.auditSummary: The Kallang precinct supports stadium-scale events and several indoor or outdoor formats within a major transport-connected sports destination.
planningConsiderations: Confirm the specific facility because capacities vary substantially across the precinct.
Coordinate crowd movement, security and transport planning from the outset.
Validate field protection, rigging, power and production-compound requirements.

venues.auditSummary: The attraction supports themed private events and incentive programmes with entertainment environments that differ from conventional hotel venues.
planningConsiderations: Confirm attraction operating boundaries and whether an individual space or wider park programme is proposed.
Plan guest routing, branding permissions and entertainment integration with the venue team.
Treat full-park buyout capacity as a separate bespoke enquiry.

venues.auditSummary: The former power station is a large industrial shell suited to high-impact installations and events that need a raw architectural backdrop.
planningConsiderations: Confirm usable zones, temporary services and fire-safety requirements for the proposed layout.
Allow additional planning for climate control, acoustics and guest comfort.
Review floor loading, access doors and production vehicle routes before design development.

venues.auditSummary: Singapore EXPO is a large Changi exhibition and conference campus with configurable halls and purpose-built event infrastructure.
planningConsiderations: Select the hall or APEX configuration before comparing capacities.
Map organiser offices, loading docks, registration and visitor circulation as one operational plan.
Check whether the event relies on neighbouring halls or a single contained venue.

venues.auditSummary: The Star Theatre is a large fixed-seat performance venue with strong stage and auditorium infrastructure in the one-north precinct.
planningConsiderations: A fixed-seat theatre works differently from a flat-floor ballroom; confirm stage, backstage and foyer requirements.
Review sightlines and production positions before allocating seats.
Plan interval, registration and catering flows around theatre operations.

venues.auditSummary: The ballroom sits within the broader Resorts World Sentosa MICE ecosystem, which is undergoing renewed event-space development in 2026.
planningConsiderations: Request the current 2026 floor plan because ballroom configurations may have changed.
Confirm whether adjacent foyer or convention spaces are included.
Coordinate hotel, attraction and dining components as part of one delegate journey.

venues.auditSummary: Suntec provides central-city convention halls, meeting rooms and auditorium configurations with established MICE services.
planningConsiderations: Match the capacity to the exact level and hall combination.
Plan loading, registration and vertical guest movement around other activity in the centre.
Confirm included AV infrastructure versus temporary production scope.

venues.auditSummary: The Orchard hotel provides a large ballroom and multiple breakout spaces in a central shopping and hospitality district.
planningConsiderations: Compare ballroom capacity after stage, production and catering footprints are deducted.
Use the breakout-room inventory to plan concurrent sessions.
Confirm hotel arrival, parking and supplier access during peak Orchard periods.

venues.auditSummary: Science Centre Singapore supports educational, family-day and corporate formats with interactive attractions and distinctive event settings.
planningConsiderations: Confirm whether galleries or attractions remain public during the event.
Plan programme timing around interactive experiences rather than treating the site as a blank hall.
Check catering, weather cover and guest movement for outdoor or marquee formats.

venues.auditSummary: Shangri-La Singapore combines large ballrooms, extensive breakout options, hotel rooms and landscaped surroundings in the Orchard area.
planningConsiderations: Theatre, reception and banquet capacities differ materially; confirm the actual layout.
Review foyer, registration and breakout requirements alongside the main ballroom.
Plan transport for guests who are not staying at the hotel.

venues.auditSummary: The Ocean Gallery creates an immersive aquarium backdrop for dinners and receptions within Resorts World Sentosa.
planningConsiderations: Use the specific Ocean Gallery capacity rather than a whole-attraction attendance estimate.
Confirm restrictions on lighting, sound, decor and animal-welfare-sensitive production.
Plan arrival timing and guest movement through the attraction.

venues.auditSummary: Esplanade offers purpose-built performance halls and public-facing cultural spaces in a prominent Marina Bay waterfront location.
planningConsiderations: Confirm whether gallery seats are being opened when using the maximum capacity.
Review stage, orchestra, acoustic and technical requirements with the venue production team.
Plan foyer activity and public circulation around the wider arts centre.

venues.auditSummary: The Marina Bay hotel provides a pillarless ballroom, smaller rooms and indoor-outdoor event options for premium corporate and social programmes.
planningConsiderations: Different official pages publish different capacities by layout; use the exact event format.
Confirm which LED walls and in-house production elements are included.
Check foyer and service circulation when combining reception and dinner programmes.

venues.auditSummary: ArtScience Museum offers design-led museum spaces for smaller receptions, launches and private functions rather than conventional large hall formats.
planningConsiderations: Use the published rental space capacity rather than overall museum visitor numbers.
Confirm exhibition access, operating hours and installation restrictions.
Plan branding and production to respect museum finishes and visitor routes.

venues.auditSummary: The CBD hotel supports mid-sized corporate events with ballroom, meeting-room and high-floor hospitality infrastructure.
planningConsiderations: Use the current official 600-person maximum rather than older third-party records.
Confirm lift and loading access for production equipment.
Plan arrival flows around weekday CBD traffic and office peaks.

venues.auditSummary: Capella combines a premium ballroom, heritage rooms and lawns in a low-density Sentosa resort setting.
planningConsiderations: Confirm current ballroom and lawn capacities directly because public room data may vary by event type.
Plan wet-weather movement between indoor and outdoor components.
Review transport and guest arrival arrangements for destination-style programmes.

venues.auditSummary: The museum provides heritage architecture, gallery-adjacent areas, a theatre and smaller function spaces in the Civic District.
planningConsiderations: Confirm the current venue-rental toolkit and individual-space capacity.
Review exhibition, conservation, decor and food-service restrictions.
Plan public access, security and installation work around museum operations.

venues.auditSummary: The heritage hotel offers premium ballrooms and function rooms suited to formal corporate and social occasions in the Civic District.
planningConsiderations: Confirm the current room chart and layout because heritage spaces have distinct usable dimensions.
Coordinate production design with the protected architectural character.
Review supplier access and service routes before finalising the event layout.
